power and phase-shift variants all stall around 2–4e-3, and the residual has no clear dependence on any single input.

The model that came closest at 1.7e-3 used the drive at ω ≈ 0.357 with x·cos/x·sin terms and a damping term in v. Its coefficients were not clean, so it is not a credible exact law.
